description: Ring up sales on the POS tablets; take card and SNAP EBT payments on the P2PE terminals; take cash; print receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 75% of sales are card or EBT (about $2,200 of the $3,000 daily sales); shoppers leave a full cart when cards fail; SNAP customers cannot pay at all; sales records live in the platform
manual_workaround: Cash only, using the printed price list and a paper tally sheet; sign at the door; record sales in the dashboard when it returns; never write down card numbers
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03 (countertop terminals); SYS-05 (POS tablets); SYS-06
dependent_third_parties: Payment and commerce platform provider; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: 2 Cashiers; Store Manager; store front end

description: Customers browse the online store, place orders, and pay at the provider-hosted checkout; order alerts reach the store phone
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 5 orders and $275 a day; customers switch to delivery apps or other stores after a day; orders and payments live in the platform
manual_workaround: Take orders by phone; customers pay at pickup on a countertop P2PE terminal; pause delivery; post a banner on the online store
dependent_third_parties: Payment and commerce platform provider; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Store Manager; Order Picker and Delivery Driver

business_process: Order picking, curbside pickup, and delivery
description: Pick online orders, hand them over at the curb, and deliver within about 5 miles; take pay-on-delivery payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Perishable and frozen items must reach customers the same day; delivery slots are promised to the hour
manual_workaround: Print the day's pick lists from the dashboard each morning; call customers to reschedule; delivery orders must be prepaid online or paid at the store
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-05 (store phone); SYS-03 (mobile reader, until retired)
dependent_third_parties: Payment and commerce platform provider; mobile carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Order Picker and Delivery Driver; delivery vehicle

description: Watch case and walk-in temperatures; act on alerts; discard and record stock that was too warm
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A cooler or freezer failure overnight can spoil several thousand dollars of stock; unsafe food reaching customers is the worst outcome; alerts depend on the Wi-Fi and internet
manual_workaround: Manual thermometer checks every 2 hours while open and at closing, recorded on a paper log; move product to working cases; call the refrigeration repair company
dependent_systems: SYS-08; SYS-06; Owner and Store Manager phones
dependent_third_parties: Sensor vendor (cloud app); internet provider; refrigeration repair company; electric utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; Store Manager; Stock and Produce Clerk

description: Receive deliveries; update item costs and prices; print shelf tags; mark down near-date items (with AI suggestions, P10)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Shelf prices stay valid; missed markdowns add spoilage; supplier invoices must match receipts
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log; keep current shelf prices; handwritten markdown stickers approved by the Store Manager
dependent_third_parties: Payment and commerce platform provider; suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Stock and Produce Clerk; Store Manager

description: Record daily sales and expenses; pay supplier invoices; send hours to the payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; suppliers expect payment on terms; sales tax returns depend on daily sales records; cash reserve covers about 3 weeks
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; pay urgent suppliers by check; rebuild daily sales from platform reports
dependent_systems: SYS-07; SYS-04; SYS-05 (office PC); SYS-01 (sales reports)
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; payroll service; productivity suite vendor

description: Look up and add loyalty members at checkout; answer the shared orders mailbox and the store phone; send offers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missing points or offers annoy customers but do not stop sales
manual_workaround: Write phone numbers on a paper list and add points later; answer the store phone; delay offers
